scenario.gamification-happy.summary: The authenticated administrator route loaded with a populated season and six visible standings.

steps.step.open-populated-gamification: Opened /gamification at 1920x1080; the command center, season, metrics, leaderboard, and governance queue rendered.

oracle.populated-state-visible.observed: Dynamic Demo Season and six populated standings were visible.

scenario.gamification-visual.summary: The repaired full-screen composition has one H1, a flattened season summary, and one compact metric rail.

steps.step.capture-desktop-visual: Captured the 1920x1080 command center and governance workspace after repair.

oracle.command-center-coherent.observed: The first viewport preserves route hierarchy without duplicate headings or four repeated KPI cards.

scenario.gamification-responsive.summary: At 768x900 the page did not overflow horizontally; metrics reflowed 2x2 and the leaderboard owned its horizontal scroll.

steps.step.capture-compact-layout: Resized to 768x900 and measured the page, metric strip, tabs, and leaderboard scroll owner.

oracle.compact-layout-screenshot.observed: The compact layout remained legible and contained.

scenario.gamification-boundary-empty.summary: A guaranteed-missing member query produced an explicit empty state.

steps.step.apply-impossible-member-filter: Entered no-such-member-zzzz in the leaderboard search.

oracle.explicit-empty-result.actual_value: No season standings match the current filters.
oracle.explicit-empty-result.observed: The table displayed No season standings match the current filters.

scenario.gamification-validation.summary: Manual EXP could not be submitted without an eligible selected member.

steps.step.submit-invalid-manual-exp: Opened Grant Manual EXP without selecting a search result.

oracle.invalid-correction-blocked.observed: The Grant EXP action remained disabled.

scenario.gamification-recovery.summary: Clearing the impossible filter restored six standings.

steps.step.clear-impossible-filter: Cleared the leaderboard query with keyboard input and waited for state recovery.

scenario.gamification-modal.summary: The Active to Closed lifecycle mutation required confirmation and cancel preserved Active.

steps.step.open-and-cancel-lifecycle: Expanded season lifecycle controls, opened Close confirmation, and selected Cancel.

oracle.lifecycle-cancel-safe.observed: The season remained Active after cancellation.

oracle.lifecycle-modal-visible.observed: The confirmation dialog described the Active to Closed transition.

scenario.gamification-governance-tabs.summary: Integrity, Rankings, and Audit log were all reachable and exposed distinct panels.

steps.step.visit-every-governance-view: Visited all three tabs and returned to Integrity.

oracle.governance-tabs-reachable.observed: Every governance tab selected and rendered its corresponding panel.

steps.step.search-manual-exp-member: Searched ma and observed 20 realistic eligible member results after the request completed.

oracle.manual-member-search-bounded.observed: The list returned exactly 20 visible matches and did not preload the full directory.

exploration_results.observed: The compact viewport and guaranteed-missing query both remained bounded and recoverable.
